entry.title: Superseded architecture note
entry.summary: A published-but-superseded architecture note kept as the stale related-target so the demonstrator can render a real superseded status marker.
entry.content:
This note describes an earlier approach that has since been replaced. It is kept published — rather than deleted — so that a related reference pointing at it resolves to a real page whose doc_status is superseded.

Because resolveRelated fails the build on a dangling reference, the stale-target status marker (FR-005) needs an actual superseded page to point at. This is that page: the blocks demonstrator links here to show the superseded marker on a Related card.
